fact: Car 22 left the track and retained position, at Turn 12, whilst Car 81 was attempting an overtaking move.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video and in-car video evidence. The Stewards note that the Team instructed the driver of Car 22 to give the position back. The driver complied with that instruction and hence the Stewards take no further action.
rules_referenced: Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
team: Visa Cash App RB F1 Team
title: Decision Car 22 Alleged Leaving The Track And Gaining An Advantage
